inspiration: A nine-slice UI kit: button, listbox, slider, scrollbar, checkbox and tab pieces are small fixed-size pieces that stretch to fit. Recreate with our own corner ornament and bevel: one frame grammar, fixed corner sizes, and pieces that scale to any screen.
Active and inactive tab pair: each tab has two small images for the selected and idle states, so state reads by swapping one piece. A cheap, clear pattern for our menu tabs.

Damage colour language: combat text and the font colour table are defined in plain text files, so each damage type has one colour across all floating numbers. Copy the idea with our own damage-type set and palette.

Two compass projections: one compass for orthogonal maps and one for isometric maps (compass_ortho and compass_iso). For our camera, a direction marker that matches the camera projection, drawn in our style.
Text-driven menus and cutscenes: menus and intro or credits are text definitions that point at images and timings, so layout changes do not need code. Worth copying for our menu and cutscene data.
